methods.name: describe
methods.doc: Describe several references for one configuration surface. Batched because a settings page describes every reference its rows name at once, and one round trip keeps those rows from settling separately.

methods.name: set
methods.doc: Store one value from a configuration surface. The value crosses the wire in this direction only: no read path returns it.

methods.name: unset
methods.doc: Remove one reference from a configuration surface.

props.name: configured
props.doc: Whether resolving the reference would currently return a value.

props.name: source
props.doc: Source layer currently supplying the value; absent while unconfigured.

props.name: writable
props.doc: Whether the active provider can write this reference.

CredentialInfo.doc: Source and writability facts for one reference, safe for configuration UIs — never the value. The view has no slot a value could ride in, which is what lets the whole read half cross the Remote wire.
